name: leafpic
description: A Reflections leaf's picture, drawn in ink on paper: the week's moods as seven dots, what each day kept (a pen and a microphone), the week's recordings as bars, or this week's days beside the weeks before as columns. The picture is said aloud as one sentence (role img); a mood colour is only support, the word is in the title and the caption.

kind.description: week: the day letters over seven dots (26px at most), a kept day filled in its mood, an empty day a 1.5px ring at 28% --rule; a day can be before joining (dashed), still ahead (dotted) or today (a ring round it). kept: a column per day, a pen square over a microphone square (26px, --r), filled --rule where kept, a dashed ring where not. recordings: a bar per recording (its day, the bar, its length), the longest in full --rule, the rest at 40%. weeks: four columns, the weeks before and then this one in full --rule, each labelled by its date.

loading.description: The picture's skeleton (v4 round 10): the same grid, the day letters real, each mark in bone (a dot, a kept square, a recording's bar at a set share, a week's column), the lengths, labels and caption in bone; aria-hidden, no say.

say.description: The picture in one sentence, its accessible name: "Monday even, Wednesday low, Thursday low, Saturday good, Sunday even."

caption.description: A line under the picture, in labels: the week's "Mon even · Wed low · Thu low · Sat good · Sun even", the sleep days "Wed, Thu, Sat, Sun". Seen, not read (the say carries it).

days.description: week and kept: the seven days, Monday first. week: { dow: "M", mood?: light|good|even|low|hard (a kept day), day?: before|ahead, today?: true, title?: "Mon 3: Even" }. kept: { dow, written: bool, recorded: bool, title?: "Mon 3" }.

recs.description: recordings: the week's recordings in order, { day: "Wed", len: "11:47" }. The bars are drawn to the longest, which is drawn in full --rule.

weeks.description: weeks: the columns, oldest first, { label: "13 Jul" | "This week", n: days here (of 7), current?: true }.

exposes.--aj-c-leafpic-share: A bar's share of the longest recording, or a column's of seven days, written on it by the render (recs, weeks).

states.hover: n/a: nothing in it is pressed; a dot or a square names its day and mood in its title
states.focus-visible: n/a: not focusable; it is read as one image
states.loading: yes: loading, the picture's own grid with its marks in bone (Reflections' skeleton)
states.empty: n/a: a week with a reflection has a kept day; the week so far draws the days still to come as dotted rings (week, day ahead)

a11y.role: img (a figure), named by say; the drawing and the caption are aria-hidden

responsive.all: the week and kept pictures keep seven columns at most 290px wide; the dots shrink with a narrow column (26px at most), the squares stay 26px

changelog.change: New (v4 C3): the four pictures of explore booklet-feel f-mix (shared/cards.css).
v4 round 10 fixes 5: loading draws the picture in bone in its own grid, for Reflections' skeleton.
